artworks.title: M.L.P.F. Esquirou de Parieu
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing sideways on a raised platform or podium, reading from a piece of paper. The man has exaggerated facial features, wearing a dark suit with a high-collared shirt and bow tie. He appears focused as an indistinct crowd surrounds him. The background indicates a lecture or speech setting. The man holds the paper as he reads, with no visible jewelry or additional objects in sight.

artworks.title: Achille Fould
artworks.description: The illustration features a man with an exaggeratedly large head standing upright with his arms crossed over his chest. The man has a serious expression, dark, slicked-back hair, and is dressed in a dark, long coat with matching pants and shoes. In the background, there are faint outlines of multiple people and a figure on a podium or platform. The background is sketched with loose, light lines suggesting depth and perspective.

artworks.title: H.M. Augustin Corne
artworks.description: The image shows a caricature of a man in a suit with a bow tie, holding a glass while leaning on a pedestal. The man has exaggerated features, including a large nose and chin. He has neatly styled hair and round spectacles.

artworks.title: Ferdinand Favre
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body caricature of a person in profile, striding to the right with an exaggerated posture. The figure has a large head with distinct facial features such as a long nose, pronounced brow, closed eyes, large lips, and voluminous hair styled in waves. The person wears a dark suit with stripes, a white shirt, and is set against a background of faceless figures. No accessories or objects are depicted in the image.

artworks.title: Prince Lucien Murat
artworks.description: The image shows a man in formal 19th-century attire standing with a slight turn to his body, facing the viewer. He has a stylized mustache and goatee, short-cropped hair, and a relaxed expression. He wears a dark suit jacket, white shirt with a high collar, striped trousers, and holds a walking stick with one hand while the other rests on his belly. A top hat is held behind his back. The background is a simple, shaded design that does not depict any specific scenery.

artworks.title: J. Marie Joseph Deville
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body depiction of a person sitting on a bench or ledge. The person is seated with one leg crossed over the other. The individual's facial features are exaggerated, with a prominent nose, full lips, and large, intense eyes. The hair is tousled and appears wavy. They are wearing a dark jacket and lighter-colored pants, with the jacket flowing over the side of the bench. The person's posture adds to the overall dramatic effect created by the image. The background is minimally detailed, mostly consisting of shaded lines that suggest depth and contrast against the lighter areas.

artworks.title: Félix Saint-Priest
artworks.description: The image shows a caricature of a person standing upright. The person has exaggerated facial features, with a long, elongated face and pronounced nose. The hair is messy and stands up at various angles. They are wearing round spectacles that appear quite large. The clothing consists of a dark, buttoned uniform, and the person is holding a box or chest in their hands. An envelope is visible in their grasp. In the background, there are sketches of several figures, likely a crowd, drawn in a lighter pencil. The setting appears to be busy, with various expressions and postures depicted among the background figures. The scene is rendered in a monochromatic pencil sketch style.

artworks.title: J.-B. Gustave de Laboulie
artworks.description: The image shows a caricature of a man with exaggerated proportions. He has a small body and a large head, with a receding hairline, short hair, and round spectacles. The man is dressed in a dark suit with a patterned texture, including a jacket, trousers, and a tie. His facial features include a prominent nose and slightly pursed lips. The background is a plain surface with indistinct lines for shading. There is a signature in the lower left corner and the number '53' in the lower right corner of the image.

artworks.title: Marie Denis Larabit
artworks.description: The image depicts a full-body caricature of a man seated on a ledge or step. The man is sideways to the viewer, with crossed legs and arms folded. He has exaggerated facial features, curly hair, and is dressed in a dark suit with striped trousers and formal shoes. A piece of fabric, possibly a handkerchief, is beside him on the ledge. The background is lightly sketched, indicating a simple setting.

artworks.title: Ch. Ferdinand Gambon
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body caricature of a man standing. He has one hand on his hip and the other resting on a podium or block. The man's facial features are exaggerated, including a prominent forehead, intense eyebrows, a large, bushy beard and mustache. He has long hair flowing to the shoulders. He is dressed in a formal suit with a long coat, vest, and trousers. The background is plain with some light shading. There are no visible accessories or objects in his hands apart from the podium.

artworks.title: Emmanuel Arago
artworks.description: The illustration depicts a man standing in a slightly hunched position with his right hand in his pants' pocket and his left hand resting on a table or ledge. The man has exaggerated facial features, a large forehead, rounded cheeks, and prominent eyes. He has medium-length, wavy, dark hair, and is dressed in a dark suit with a light-colored shirt and a small bow tie. The background features a simple, textured design with subtle shading to emphasize the figure.

artworks.title: Comte de Montalembert
artworks.description: The image shows a caricature of a man depicted in a full-body portrait. His facial features are exaggerated—his head is quite large with distinct, prominent brow lines, slightly squinting eyes, a broad nose, and a pronounced mouth. His hair is dark, medium-length, and slightly tousled. The man is wearing a long coat, trousers, and pointed shoes. In his left hand, he is holding a book, while his right hand holds a top hat. The background consists of light shading with cross-hatching.

artworks.title: Alex. Ch. Henri de Tocqueville
artworks.description: The image is a full-body caricature of a person with exaggerated features. The individual is standing upright, slightly leaned back, holding a folded document or paper. The person has a large head, elongated eyes, a prominent nose, and a small mouth. They have dark, voluminous hair styled to curl outward and wear a formal suit with a high-collared shirt and a bow tie. The background is plain with a gradient effect.

artworks.title: Charles Dupin
artworks.description: The image shows a caricature of a man sitting with his legs crossed. He is leaning back slightly against a bench, with his arms folded across his chest. The caricature emphasizes his exaggerated features, such as a large, elongated head with pronounced cheekbones and a slightly pointed chin, wide and expressive eyes, and dark, disheveled hair combed back. He is wearing a dark coat with a high collar, a white shirt, light-colored pants, and dark shoes. The background includes faint outlines of other figures engaging in conversation.

artworks.title: Arm. Jacques Lherbette
artworks.description: The image features a man with exaggerated caricature proportions in a full-body stance. The man's facial features are emphasized, with a large head, a prominent forehead, a sharp nose, short dark hair styled to the side, small eyeglasses, and a profile view facing left. He is wearing an elegant, dark suit with a long coat, a waistcoat, a white shirt, and a bow tie, and is carrying a bundle of rolled papers under his left arm. In the background, there are light, indistinct figures of people, suggesting a group setting. The background consists of sketchy lines, implying a crowd in a monochromatic style.

artworks.title: Un Lutteur malheureux
artworks.description: The image shows a seated man and a standing figure interacting. The seated man is shown almost fully, his posture slouched with his limbs appearing thin and gaunt. His facial features are pronounced, with hollow cheeks and a scraggly appearance. His hair is sparse and disheveled. He wears only a pair of striped shorts, leaving his upper body bare, and he is seated on a simple chair. He holds a cracked bowl in his left hand. The standing figure, dressed fully in a long dark coat and hat, leans over the seated man with a stern expression. Their facial features are less visible due to the shading of the hat, but they have a long, pointed nose. This figure holds a card or document in their left hand close to the seated man's face. The background is simple and lacks detail, with some sketched shading and a name signed at the bottom left corner of the image. On the ground next to the seated man lies a piece of paper with the word "INTÉRIEUR" inscribed on it.

artworks.title: Un Jeune homme qui est l'espoir... de la famille Badinguet
artworks.description: The image displays three individuals walking together. In the middle, an older man in a formal suit with a white waistcoat and top hat, along with round spectacles. To his left, a young boy in a dark outfit with a wide-brimmed hat. To his right, a woman in a long gown and shawl, holding the man's arm. They are set against a lightly sketched background with faint outlines of other figures wearing top hats.

artworks.title: Deux bons voisins
artworks.description: The image shows two people depicted in an illustrative, sketch-like manner. One person is seen from behind, tipping a brimmed cap. This person has short, light-colored hair and is wearing a long, striped coat with checkered pants. The other person is shown from the waist up, leaning over the opposite side of a wall and tipping a top hat. This person has slightly longer, dark hair and is wearing a dark jacket. The background features a sketch of trees and shrubbery. The setting suggests a casual encounter between the two individuals on different sides of a stone wall.

artworks.title: Parisien transportant dans un autre quartier...
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing and holding a potted plant in one hand and a birdcage in the other. He is wearing a long coat, trousers, and a top hat. Another figure is in the background walking towards a large wooden cart with the word "DEMÉNAGEM" on it. Buildings are visible in the background. The scene is sketched in a shaded style.

artworks.title: Chicken Vendor, Trinidad
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an outdoor market scene. The drawing portrays a bustling outdoor market setting with a variety of details emphasizing the market's energy. In the foreground, several baskets and bunches of poultry are evident. The background is filled with straw-roofed structures and numerous figures hinting at an active market day. The atmosphere is richly textured, and the shading is detailed, highlighting the emphasis on movement and activity. Trees and foliage peer in from behind the structures under a cloudy or hazy sky.

artworks.title: Bringing Goats to Market
artworks.description: The image shows a rural scene with animals and buildings. A group of animals is gathered in the foreground, with rustic structures in the background. Soft hues of blue, orange, and green create a dreamlike quality. The scene appears to be set in a village with features like thatched roofs and sketched figures suggesting motion or daily activities. The style resembles that of Paul Gauguin, emphasizing mood and atmosphere over detail.

artworks.title: Bathing Beach
artworks.description: This is a painting of a coastal scene with figures near the sea. The image depicts a foggy or misty seascape with faint outlines of figures along the shore. These figures appear to be lounging or interacting near the water’s edge. The background is hazy, suggesting a landscape that fades into the distance. The colors are soft and muted, with a predominant use of blues and browns. The scene gives a sense of tranquility and movement, with waves crashing into the shore subtly captured. The water turns into wisps resembling mist in the air. This is in style of J.M.W. Turner, recognized for his atmospheric landscapes and use of light and color to evoke mood.

artworks.title: Picnic Party
artworks.description: This is a painting of an outdoor scene featuring a group engaged in leisure activities near the seaside. The composition shows a gathering under a makeshift canopy, with a long table set with fruits and dishes, suggesting a meal or social occasion. In the foreground, there are two individuals seated, one is tending to their hair and another engaging in conversation. Nearby, a child is seen on a donkey, guided by an adult, towards the shoreline where a sailboat glides on calm waters. The overall ambiance suggests a casual day at the beach. The painting is done in an impressionistic style with the use of light and social setting reminiscent of works by artists such as Marcel Duchamp.

artworks.title: The Brook
artworks.medium: color etching and softground with monotype
artworks.description: The artwork depicts two figures in a natural setting. The foremost figure is seated with legs submerged in water and a turned head slightly towards the back. The second figure stands beside the first with a slight forward lean. Both individuals are shown from head to toe, featuring indistinct facial details and unclothed bodies. The surrounding environment suggests a rocky landscape covered in brushstroke-like textures that represent water. The background is a mix of dark and green tones, creating a dreamy atmosphere.
